chunks: There each soul will see what it had sent before, and they will be returned to Allah, their true Lord, and will be lost to them what they used to fabricate.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people's deeds and fabricated lies on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate reality of *al-Haqq* (the Truth) as Allah, contrasting with the *batil* (falsehood) of idols and fabricated narratives that will vanish. It underscores the concept of *hasr* (being left behind) where the deceptions of the self and false gods become useless, reinforcing the individual's direct accountability before the Divine. This moment serves as a profound reminder of the transition from the temporal world to the eternal realm of truth.
